data.name: Devraj
data.gender_notes: Devraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Devraj is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: Deva (God) and Raja (ruler). This name is often given to boys in Hindu culture, signifying the one who rules over the gods or is a god himself. The name Devraj carries the meaning “God's ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devraj usually hope their child will grow to embody god's ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of divine power and rulership.
data.etymology: Devraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devraj total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Devraj carries a rich cultural significance in Hinduism. Devraj is revered as a divine name resonating with the divine essence of God. It suggests the possessor of godly power and the one who holds the divine authority. In certain regions of India, it is also given to boys born under specific auspicious celestial configurations. The name signifies the unity of the divine and the earthly realms, and inspires a deep sense of reverence and respect for the divine power.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Devraj lies in its divine origins and association with the supreme power of the universe. The name is a reminder of the divine soul within each individual and inspires devotion, self-realization and spiritual growth. It represents the ultimate goal of human endeavor, which is to attain divine consciousness and oneness with the universe, where one rules over one's own inner turmoils and imperfections. The name Devraj encourages the pursuit of spiritual wisdom and the development of qualities that align one with the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Devraj: God's ruler or divine king. The one who governs with the divine will and wisdom of the gods.
